in_game_description: This Emergency system creates a temporary impenetrable shield around the ship as soon as it reaches a critical level of damage. After the activation, the module becomes unusable and has to be bought again. The Galactic Tourist Agency is considering the introduction of a law that obligates all cruise ship companies to install these on their vessels.
mechanics_text: Creates a temporary impenetrable shield for 10000ms (10 seconds) when ship reaches critical damage.
After activation, the module is consumed and must be repurchased.
Cannot use the Khador Drive when Emergency System is active, but can still cloak.
Only available with the Valkyrie add-on.
Required for the Grave Riser orange medal (get 5 kills while Emergency System is active).
version_notes: CRITICAL: Effect 10000ms is the DURATION of the emergency shield in milliseconds (10 seconds). This is NOT a multiplier or percentage. Previous parser bug interpreted this as effect_multiplier: 10000.0 — INCORRECT. Consumable module.
